# BodaMoncadaVelasquez
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Luis &amp; Bessi — Nos casamos</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,300;0,9..144,500;0,9..144,600;1,9..144,400&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#647B84;
    --paper:#F1EDE5;
    --paper-2:#E9E3D8;
    --smoke:#C9D5DA;
    --smoke-deep:#2C3A45;
    --smoke-light:#AFC0CB;
    --brass:#E8C989;
    --line: rgba(241,237,229,0.30);
    --line-soft: rgba(241,237,229,0.14);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--paper);
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    font-weight:300;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  .sheet{
    position:relative;
    max-width:760px;
    margin:0 auto;
    padding:64px 40px;
    border-left:1px solid var(--line-soft);
    border-right:1px solid var(--line-soft);
    background:
      linear-gradient(var(--line-soft) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0/100% 28px,
      var(--paper);
  }
  .sheet.dense-grid{
    background:
      linear-gradient(var(--line-soft) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0/100% 28px,
      linear-gradient(90deg, var(--line-soft) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0/28px 100%,
      var(--bg);
  }
  .crop{
    position:absolute;
    width:22px;
    height:22px;
    opacity:0.55;
  }
  .crop::before,.crop::after{content:"";position:absolute;background:var(--paper);}
  .crop::before{width:100%;height:1px;top:50%;}
  .crop::after{height:100%;width:1px;left:50%;}
  .crop.tl{top:22px;left:22px;}
  .crop.tr{top:22px;right:22px;}
  .crop.bl{bottom:22px;left:22px;}
  .crop.br{bottom:22px;right:22px;}

  .sheet-id{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:11px;
    letter-spacing:0.12em;
    color:var(--smoke);
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    margin-bottom:56px;
  }

  /* HERO */
  .hero{padding-top:40px;padding-bottom:20px;text-align:center;}
  .mark{
    width:74px;height:74px;margin:0 auto 30px;
  }
  .eyebrow-word{
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-weight:500;
    font-size:15px;
    letter-spacing:0.28em;
    color:var(--smoke);
    margin:0 0 18px;
  }
  .names{
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-optical-sizing:auto;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:clamp(48px,10vw,84px);
    line-height:1;
    margin:0 0 22px;
    color:var(--paper);
  }
  .names .amp{
    font-style:italic;
    font-weight:400;
    color:var(--brass);
    font-size:0.62em;
    padding:0 0.12em;
  }
  .invite-line{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:13px;
    letter-spacing:0.04em;
    color:var(--smoke);
    max-width:360px;
    margin:0 auto;
    line-height:1.8;
  }

  /* PULSE DIMENSION DIVIDER */
  .pulse-wrap{
    max-width:760px;
    margin:0 auto;
    padding:0 40px;
    background:var(--bg);
  }
  .pulse-wrap svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;}

  /* PHOTO */
  .frame{
    position:relative;
    margin:46px auto;
    max-width:520px;
  }
  .frame img{
    display:block;
    width:100%;
    height:auto;
    filter: saturate(0.86) contrast(1.02);
  }
  .frame .bracket{
    position:absolute;
    width:26px;height:26px;
    border:1.5px solid var(--brass);
  }
  .frame .bracket.tl{top:-9px;left:-9px;border-right:none;border-bottom:none;}
  .frame .bracket.tr{top:-9px;right:-9px;border-left:none;border-bottom:none;}
  .frame .bracket.bl{bottom:-9px;left:-9px;border-right:none;border-top:none;}
  .frame .bracket.br{bottom:-9px;right:-9px;border-left:none;border-top:none;}
  .frame-cap{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:10.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.08em;
    color:var(--smoke);
    text-align:center;
    margin-top:14px;
  }

  .frame.wide{max-width:100%;}
  .frame.dual{
    display:flex;
    gap:18px;
    max-width:520px;
  }
  .frame.dual .frame{flex:1;margin:46px 0;}

  /* SECTION TITLES */
  .section-title{
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-style:italic;
    font-weight:400;
    font-size:28px;
    color:var(--paper);
    text-align:center;
    margin:0 0 8px;
  }
  .section-sub{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:10.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.14em;
    color:var(--brass);
    text-align:center;
    margin:0 0 44px;
  }

  /* PARENTS - legend style */
  .legend{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:0;
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .legend > div{
    padding:26px 22px;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .legend > div:first-child{border-right:1px solid var(--line);}
  .legend-key{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:10px;
    letter-spacing:0.14em;
    color:var(--smoke);
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .legend-names{
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-weight:500;
    font-size:16.5px;
    line-height:1.6;
    color:var(--paper);
  }

  /* SITE PLAN / VENUE CARDS */
  .venue{
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:34px 30px;
    margin-bottom:26px;
    position:relative;
  }
  .venue-label{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:10px;
    letter-spacing:0.14em;
    color:var(--brass);
    margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .venue-name{
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:24px;
    margin:0 0 6px;
    color:var(--paper);
  }
  .venue-loc{
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    font-weight:400;
    font-size:14px;
    color:var(--smoke);
    margin:0 0 22px;
  }
  .venue-time{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:11.5px;
    color:var(--paper);
    border-top:1px dashed var(--line);
    padding-top:14px;
    margin-bottom:22px;
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
  }
  .map-btn{
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:10px;
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:11.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    color:var(--smoke-deep);
    background:var(--brass);
    text-decoration:none;
    padding:12px 20px;
    transition:background 0.25s ease;
  }
  .map-btn:hover{background:var(--paper);}
  .map-btn svg{width:14px;height:14px;flex-shrink:0;}

  .dress{
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:30px 30px 28px;
    text-align:center;
  }

  /* ITINERARY */
  .itin-row{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:78px 24px 1fr;
    align-items:center;
    padding:15px 0;
    border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);
  }
  .itin-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .itin-time{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--paper);
  }
  .itin-node{position:relative;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  .itin-node::after{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    top:-16px;bottom:-16px;
    left:50%;
    width:1px;
    background:var(--line);
    transform:translateX(-50%);
  }
  .itin-row:first-child .itin-node::after{top:50%;}
  .itin-row:last-child .itin-node::after{bottom:50%;}
  .itin-node span{
    position:relative;
    z-index:1;
    width:13px;height:13px;
    display:block;
  }
  .itin-node span::before,
  .itin-node span::after{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    background:var(--brass);
  }
  .itin-node span::before{width:13px;height:2.5px;top:5.25px;left:0;}
  .itin-node span::after{width:2.5px;height:13px;left:5.25px;top:0;}
  .itin-event{
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-weight:500;
    font-size:15px;
    color:var(--paper);
    padding-left:4px;
  }

  /* GIFT NOTE */
  .gift-note{
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:30px 20px;
    margin:40px 0 10px;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .gift-icon{width:30px;height:30px;margin:0 auto 16px;}
  .gift-text{
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-style:italic;
    font-size:16.5px;
    line-height:1.6;
    color:var(--paper);
    max-width:420px;
    margin:0 auto;
  }

  .coord{
    position:absolute;
    bottom:8px;
    right:12px;
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:9px;
    color:var(--line);
    letter-spacing:0.05em;
  }

  /* FOOTER */
  .footer-sheet{text-align:center;padding-top:60px;padding-bottom:70px;}
  .footer-line{
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
    font-style:italic;
    font-size:20px;
    color:var(--paper);
    margin-bottom:6px;
  }
  .footer-tag{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
    font-size:11px;
    letter-spacing:0.1em;
    color:var(--brass);
  }
  .footer-note{
    margin-top:34px;
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--smoke);
    line-height:1.8;
  }

  @media (max-width:600px){
    .sheet{padding:44px 22px;}
    .legend{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .legend > div:first-child{border-right:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
    .venue-time{flex-direction:column;gap:4px;}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- HERO SHEET -->
<section class="sheet dense-grid hero">
  <span class="crop tl"></span><span class="crop tr"></span><span class="crop bl"></span><span class="crop br"></span>
  <div class="sheet-id"><span>PLANO N.º 001 — UNIÓN</span><span>ESC. 1:1</span></div>

  <svg class="mark" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="46" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M50 6 L50 18 M50 84 L50 94 M6 50 L18 50 M82 50 L94 50" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M33 43 Q33 30 50 30 Q67 30 67 43 L67 47 Q50 52 33 47 Z" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="36" y1="40" x2="64" y2="40" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-width="0.9"/>
    <path d="M50 20 L50 29 M45.5 24.5 L54.5 24.5" stroke="#E8C989" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M14 66 L34 66 L40 55 L48 76 L54 66 L86 66" stroke="#E8C989" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </svg>

  <p class="eyebrow-word">Nos casamos</p>
  <h1 class="names">LUIS <span class="amp">&amp;</span> BESSI</h1>
  <p class="invite-line">ESTAMOS FELICES DE INVITARTE A NUESTRA BODA,<br>A CONSTRUIR JUNTOS NUESTRO MATRIMONIO.</p>
</section>

<div class="pulse-wrap">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 720 44" preserveAspectRatio="none">
    <line x1="0" y1="22" x2="720" y2="22" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-opacity="0.25" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M0 22 L280 22 L296 6 L312 38 L328 14 L344 22 L720 22" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="14" x2="0" y2="30" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="720" y1="14" x2="720" y2="30" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-width="1"/>
  </svg>
</div>

<!-- PHOTO + PARENTS SHEET -->
<section class="sheet">
  <span class="crop tl"></span><span class="crop tr"></span>

  <div class="frame">
    <span class="bracket tl"></span><span class="bracket tr"></span><span class="bracket bl"></span><span class="bracket br"></span>
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Luis y Bessi">
  </div>
  <p class="frame-cap">LUIS &amp; BESSI — REGISTRO FOTOGRÁFICO 01</p>

  <p class="section-title">Con la bendición de</p>
  <p class="section-sub">NUESTROS PADRES</p>

  <div class="legend">
    <div>
      <p class="legend-key">PADRES DEL NOVIO</p>
      <p class="legend-names">JOSE MONCADA<br>Y<br>MARIA GUTIERREZ</p>
    </div>
    <div>
      <p class="legend-key">PADRES DE LA NOVIA</p>
      <p class="legend-names">JULIO VELAZQUES<br>Y<br>CLEMENTINA COREA</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- CEREMONY / RECEPTION SHEET -->
<section class="sheet dense-grid">
  <span class="crop tl"></span><span class="crop tr"></span>
  <div class="sheet-id"><span>PLANO N.º 002 — EMPLAZAMIENTO</span><span>ESC. S/E</span></div>

  <p class="section-title">El plano del día</p>
  <p class="section-sub">CEREMONIA Y RECEPCIÓN</p>

  <div class="venue">
    <p class="venue-label">01 — CEREMONIA RELIGIOSA</p>
    <p class="venue-name" style="font-size:20px;line-height:1.3;">Capilla Sagrado Corazón de Jesús<br><span style="font-size:14px;font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:0.04em;color:var(--smoke);">UNICAH</span></p>
    <p class="venue-loc">Aldea las Casitas,Tegucigalpa, Honduras</p>
    <div class="venue-time"><span>12 DE DICIEMBRE, 2026</span><span>3:30 P.M.</span></div>
    <a class="map-btn" href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=UNICAH+Tegucigalpa+Honduras" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M12 21s-7-6.2-7-11.5A7 7 0 0 1 19 9.5C19 14.8 12 21 12 21Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="9.5" r="2.4"/></svg>
      VER UBICACIÓN
    </a>
    <span class="coord">15.0N / 87.2W</span>
  </div>

  <div class="venue">
    <p class="venue-label">02 — RECEPCIÓN</p>
    <p class="venue-name"> Villa Betel</p>
    <p class="venue-loc">Carretera a Mateo, Tegucigalpa, Honduras</p>
    <div class="venue-time"><span>12 DE DICIEMBRE, 2026</span><span>6:30 P.M.</span></div>
    <a class="map-btn" href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Villa+Betel+Tegucigalpa+Honduras" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M12 21s-7-6.2-7-11.5A7 7 0 0 1 19 9.5C19 14.8 12 21 12 21Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="9.5" r="2.4"/></svg>
      VER UBICACIÓN
    </a>
    <span class="coord">15.0N / 87.2W</span>
  </div>

  <div class="dress">
    <p class="venue-label" style="margin-bottom:4px;">CÓDIGO DE VESTIMENTA</p>
    <p class="section-title" style="font-size:22px;margin-bottom:8px;">Vestimenta elegante</p>
    <p class="venue-loc" style="margin-bottom:0;">Evita el color blanco, por favor — es nuestro día.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="pulse-wrap">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 720 44" preserveAspectRatio="none">
    <line x1="0" y1="22" x2="720" y2="22" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-opacity="0.25" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M0 22 L380 22 L396 6 L412 38 L428 14 L444 22 L720 22" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="14" x2="0" y2="30" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="720" y1="14" x2="720" y2="30" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-width="1"/>
  </svg>
</div>

<!-- PHOTOS SHEET -->
<section class="sheet">
  <span class="crop bl"></span><span class="crop br"></span>
  <div class="frame dual">
    <div class="frame">
      <span class="bracket tl"></span><span class="bracket tr"></span><span class="bracket bl"></span><span class="bracket br"></span>
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="El anillo">
    </div>
    <div class="frame">
      <span class="bracket tl"></span><span class="bracket tr"></span><span class="bracket bl"></span><span class="bracket br"></span>
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Manos y flores">
    </div>
  </div>
  <p class="frame-cap">DETALLE 02 — EL COMPROMISO · DETALLE 03 — LAS MANOS</p>

  <div class="frame" style="margin-top:56px;">
    <span class="bracket tl"></span><span class="bracket tr"></span><span class="bracket bl"></span><span class="bracket br"></span>
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Bessi">
  </div>
  <p class="frame-cap">DETALLE 04 — BESSI</p>
</section>

<div class="pulse-wrap">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 720 44" preserveAspectRatio="none">
    <line x1="0" y1="22" x2="720" y2="22" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-opacity="0.25" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M0 22 L480 22 L496 6 L512 38 L528 14 L544 22 L720 22" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="14" x2="0" y2="30" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="720" y1="14" x2="720" y2="30" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-width="1"/>
  </svg>
</div>

<!-- ITINERARY SHEET -->
<section class="sheet dense-grid">
  <span class="crop tl"></span><span class="crop tr"></span>
  <div class="sheet-id"><span>PLANO N.º 003 — SECUENCIA</span><span>12.12.2026</span></div>

  <p class="section-title">Itinerario de boda</p>
  <p class="section-sub">EL RECORRIDO DE LA NOCHE</p>

  <div class="itin-list">
    <div class="itin-row"><div class="itin-time">3:30 PM</div><div class="itin-node"><span></span></div><div class="itin-event">Boda eclesiástica</div></div>
    <div class="itin-row"><div class="itin-time">6:30 PM</div><div class="itin-node"><span></span></div><div class="itin-event">Bienvenida y baile</div></div>
    <div class="itin-row"><div class="itin-time">7:00 PM</div><div class="itin-node"><span></span></div><div class="itin-event">Recepción</div></div>
    <div class="itin-row"><div class="itin-time">7:30 PM</div><div class="itin-node"><span></span></div><div class="itin-event">Plato principal</div></div>
    <div class="itin-row"><div class="itin-time">8:30 PM</div><div class="itin-node"><span></span></div><div class="itin-event">Brindis y pastel</div></div>
    <div class="itin-row"><div class="itin-time">9:00 PM</div><div class="itin-node"><span></span></div><div class="itin-event">Fiesta bailable</div></div>
    <div class="itin-row"><div class="itin-time">12:00 AM</div><div class="itin-node"><span></span></div><div class="itin-event">Fin de la ceremonia</div></div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- FOOTER SHEET -->
<section class="sheet dense-grid footer-sheet">
  <span class="crop tl"></span><span class="crop tr"></span><span class="crop bl"></span><span class="crop br"></span>
  <svg class="mark" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="margin-bottom:26px;">
    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="46" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M50 6 L50 18 M50 84 L50 94 M6 50 L18 50 M82 50 L94 50" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M33 43 Q33 30 50 30 Q67 30 67 43 L67 47 Q50 52 33 47 Z" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="36" y1="40" x2="64" y2="40" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-width="0.9"/>
    <path d="M50 20 L50 29 M45.5 24.5 L54.5 24.5" stroke="#E8C989" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M14 66 L34 66 L40 55 L48 76 L54 66 L86 66" stroke="#E8C989" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </svg>
  <div class="gift-note">
    <svg class="gift-icon" viewBox="0 0 40 40" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <path d="M20 32 C10 25 5 19 5 13.5 A7.5 7.5 0 0 1 20 11 A7.5 7.5 0 0 1 35 13.5 C35 19 30 25 20 32Z" stroke="#F1EDE5" stroke-width="1.3"/>
      <path d="M11 18 L16 18 L18.5 13 L21.5 23 L24 18 L29 18" stroke="#E8C989" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    </svg>
    <p class="gift-text">Tu presencia es nuestro mejor regalo, pero si deseas hacernos un obsequio en efectivo será bienvenido.</p>
  </div>
